bundle.shortDescription: Iskra lives at the top of your screen — and takes dictation
bundle.longDescription: Oczi puts Iskra at the top of your screen: a chat that answers through the DeepSeek API, a file you can drop straight onto her, and coloured pills for the services you connect — without leaving what you are doing. This installer is the one with dictation in it: press one key, speak, and the sentence is written into the chat on this machine, with no account, no key and nothing sent anywhere to be transcribed. The model and the two runtime libraries it needs travel inside this installer, which is why it is much larger than the ordinary one.
